in_hebrew.name: Bohrer
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bold or fearless runner
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bohrer הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German word 'boder', meaning 'bold' or 'fearless'. The suffix '-er' denotes one who runs. This name was borne by several early saints, inspiring bravery and perseverance.

The suffix '-er' denotes one who runs. This name was borne by several early saints, inspiring bravery and perseverance.

in_latin.name: Bohrer
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bold or fearless runner
in_latin.long_meaning: Bohrer est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old German word 'boder', meaning 'bold' or 'fearless'.
